summary: FAZ B2 wave-1 Task Attachments (mobile) — BLOCKING BUG found on Expo web preview. Empty state, chooser modal (Kamera/Galeri/Dosya) and '+ Ekle' entry-point (task-detail-attach-add) all render correctly; Devret regression still passes. BUT the actual upload fails on WEB for BOTH 'Galeri' and 'Dosya' with backend 422: {"detail":[{"type":"value_error","loc":["body","chunk"],"msg":"Value error, Expected UploadFile, received: <class 'str'>"}]}. RCA: /app/mobile/src/api/client.ts uploadAttachment() appends the file part as the RN-only shape { uri, name, type } — on the web preview browser FormData serializes this plain object to the literal string "[object Object]", so the multipart 'chunk' field arrives as a string, not an UploadFile. This blocks list/thumbnail/preview/delete flows on web because no upload can ever succeed. Also raw JSON error body is shown to the user verbatim (minor UX).

integration_issues.issue: Multipart 'chunk' field is sent as string '[object Object]' instead of a File because FormData.append with a plain {uri,name,type} object only works on React Native native platforms. Backend returns 422 (Expected UploadFile, received str). Reference: /app/mobile/src/api/client.ts uploadAttachment lines 166-174.

action_items: Fix web upload path in /app/mobile/src/api/client.ts uploadAttachment: on web (Platform.OS === 'web' or typeof window !== 'undefined'), fetch the picked asset uri and append a real Blob/File to FormData instead of the RN {uri,name,type} object. Example: const blob = await (await fetch(file.uri)).blob(); form.append('chunk', new File([blob], file.name, { type: file.type })). Keep the RN branch for native.
Alternatively, on web branch on the picker output: DocumentPicker.getDocumentAsync and ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync on web expose asset.file (native File) — append that directly when present.
Wrap the upload error surface (AttachmentsSection setError) to convert raw JSON detail/422 bodies into a friendly Turkish message (e.g. 'Dosya yüklenemedi.') and log the raw detail to console only.

After the fix, re-run web preview tests for: image upload -> thumbnail render (expo-image with auth headers), tap-to-open full-screen preview modal + task-detail-attach-preview-close, document open (Sharing/download), and delete via task-detail-attach-delete-<id> -> 'Dosyayı sil?' confirm -> Sil.

rca of the issue: React Native's non-standard FormData allows appending { uri, name, type } as a file part; the JS engine on RN then reads the URI and sends a proper multipart file. The browser (react-native-web) uses the standard DOM FormData whose append(name, value) stringifies non-Blob/File values via String(value) → '[object Object]'. Backend endpoint POST /api/tasks/{id}/attachments/chunk declares Pydantic UploadFile for 'chunk', so it fails with value_error. Reproduction: (1) login mobile web as serkan, (2) open any task detail, (3) tap '+ Ekle' -> 'Galeri' or 'Dosya', (4) pick any local file — 422 immediately. Mitigation: on web, convert the picked uri to a Blob/File before appending to FormData (see action_items #1).
